# Urban Genetics Atlas

> Interactive atlas for reading Hong Kong through its urban fabric, spatial patterns and market context.

Live Atlas: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/

Full public context: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/llms-full.txt
Detailed context: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/atlas-context.md
Plain-text context: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/atlas-context.txt
Public release manifest: https://852lab.github.io/Urban-Genetics-Atlas/release-manifest.json

Review the live interface first, then the public context and implementation files.

Focus on Urban Analysis, Urban Genetic Signature (UGS), spatial fingerprints, urban condition, modelled change, observed activity, popup behaviour, Urban Fabric controls, desktop/mobile behaviour and data limitations.

Important: **UGS describes urban condition; it is not a redevelopment prediction.**

Renewal and Genesis are assumption-led strategic models rather than neutral observations of existing condition.

Current release: V1.5-20260910-020423
